opening.argument: The promotion leads with a daily income claim and then gives viewers a concrete path to pursue it. Its title promises “Make $1,000+/DAY with Ethereum MEV Trading Bot,” while the speaker teaches viewers “step by step how to deploy an Ethereum trading bot.” The instructions require depositing “at least .2 ETH” into the contract or bot address, clicking start, and relying on a claimed withdrawal of the initial Ethereum plus profit. The income narrative is unusually rapid and substantial: the speaker reports “31% profit already” and weeks of “3-6 ETH, sometimes more.” Although profits are said to fluctuate, the contract’s actual behavior is not established, leaving viewers directed to fund and activate a bot on the strength of exceptional return claims.
